Roads damaged due to floods in
Mumbai
*321. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:
SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether following the recent
unprecedented floods in Mumbai, the State
Government of Maharashtra has sought
any special technical and other aid from his
Ministry for speedy upgrading and
reconstruction of roads and bridges in
Mumbai;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's response thereto?
Creation of a gene bank
*322. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to create a gene bank for private
and public organisations;
(b) if so, the modalities worked out in
this regard so far; and
(c) the funds allocated for the current
Five Year Plan for this purpose?
Funds for roads in NE Region
*323. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds allotted and
utilised during the last three years in the
States of North Eastern Region under road
funds to upgrade highways and main
district roads of the NER; and
(b) the names of the roads for which
allocations had been made and the details
of the progress of works on these roads of
the region during this period?

Investment in ARIs
*324. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI:
 Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES  be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of investments made in
agro and rural industries during the last three
years and as on date in different States,
State-wise;
(b) what are the problems of these
industries; and
(c) what strategy has been devised to
give a boost to the agro and rural industries?
State-wise teledensity
†*325. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the telephone density in rural and
urban areas during the last year and this
year till now, State-wise;
(b) whether the telephone density in
rural areas is less than that in urban areas;
(c) if so, the details thereof, State-wise
and the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken by Government to increase the
telephone density in rural areas particularly
in the rural areas of Orissa and Himachal
Pradesh?
Nehru Yuva Kendras in Punjab
*326. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
YOUTH AFFARIS AND SPORTS be
pleased to state:
(a) the numbr of Nehru Yuva Kendras
functioning in Punjab at present, location-
wise; and
(b) the details of the programmes being
run by these Kendras during the last three
years and the current year alongwith
performance of these Kendras?
Conditions imposed by USA on
nuclear deal
*327. SHRI MANOJ
BHATTACHARYA: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that ever since
the Indo-US Nuclear deal was signed, the
U.S. administration has been asking for
more concessions and placing the burden
of meeting conditions associated with the
deal entirely on India;
(b) if so, details thereof; and
(c) Government's reaction thereto?
Opening of LoC for relief work
*328. SHRI SHARAD YADAV:
SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL:
 Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to open points on LoC between J&K and
PoK with a view to provide assistance to
recent earthquake victims which has hit
the region;

101
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
amount of assistance provided/likely to be
provided at these points for the victims,
especially for those belonging to Pok; and
(c) the number of victims who have
attended camps opened at these points and
what is their response to it?
Abolition of Administrative Tribunals
*329. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
  Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal under
Government's consideration to abolish the
Central Administrative Tribunals and the
States Administrative Tribunals;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons for taking such a decision; and
(c) what would be the fate of the
employees of these tribunals after their
abolition?
Guidelines on child labour
*330. SHRI RAJU PARMAR: Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated the guidelines on child labour;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether it is a fact that many States
are not implementing the guidelines; and
(d) if so, the action taken against these
States for non-compliance of the
guidelines?
Status of PIOs vis-a-vis NRIs
*331. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI KAMLA
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of  OVERSEAS
INDIAN AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
representations seeking clarifications on the
status of Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs)
vis-a-vis Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) in
domestic aviation sector;
(b) if so, what action Government have
taken or propose to take in this regard;
(c) whether according to recent
amendment in Citizenship Act, 1955, noti-
fication of the Ministry of Home Affairs,
FEMA and RBI Regulations, there is parity
to PIOs with NRIs in respect of FDI in Air
Transport Services (Domestic Airlines);
(d) if so, the reasons for creating
discrimination for PIOs in aviation sector
inspite of existing well-conceived policy
of Government; and
(e) what steps Government have taken
to clear the ambiguity on FDI in aviation
sector?
Telecom facilities in rural areas of
Maharashtra
*332. SHRI VASANT CHAVAN: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the scheme for providing telecom
facilities to rural areas in Maharashtra;
(b) the total number of villages in
Maharashtra where "wireless in local loop"
services have been provided, so far;
(c) the number of villages where no
telecom facilities exist; and

102
(d) the steps taken to provide telecom
facilities in those villages?
National Highways in Uttar Pradesh
*333. PROF. M. M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any new Road Policy for
development, expansion and maintenance
of the various roads including National
Highways in the country particularly in
Uttar Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of steps taken or proposed
to be taken by Government to implement
the above policy?
Availability of Sim Cards in
Jharkhand
†*334. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of applications pending
for excel pre-paid Sim Card of Bharat
Sanchar Nigam Limited in Jharkhand;
(b) by when the Sim Cards are likely to
be made available to them; and
(c) by when the system of making excel
pre-paid Sim Card available on demand
would be brought in place?
E-auction of coal
†*335. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
Will the PRIME MINISTER  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the sale of
coal through E-auction was introduced in
the country;
(b) if so, the date on which the said
process for sale of coal was introduced;
(c) whether it is also a fact that certain
people had objected to the said process;
and
(d) if so, the facts thereof and whether
the Gauhati High Court has declared the
said process as unconstitutional, if so, the
process to be adopted by the Government
for the sale of Coal?
Demand for opening of Stilwell road
to Myanmar
*336. SHRI NABAM REBIA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there has
been an increasing demand for re-opening
of the historic Stilwell road to Myanmar;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government have decided to give its nod
to such a proposal; and
(c) if so, the details of the same including
the stipulated time period within which
the proposal would materialise?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Use of earthquake resistant
technology for buildings
†*337. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
 Will the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the parts of country hit by the
earthquake in October, 2005 and what is
the loss of life and property suffered by
the States along with their names;
(b) to what degree Delhi is safe from
earthquakes;
(c) the steps taken by Government for
compulsory use of earthquake resistant-
technology in the newly built buildings;
(d) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(e) by when a final decision would be
taken in this direction?
PPF for unorganised sector
*338. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI K. B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Public
Provident Fund (PPF) covers less than one
in every thousand workers in the
unorganised sector;
(b) whether it is further a fact that PPF
has not been very successful in attracting
low income earners;
(c) whether it is also a fact that over
half of PPF customers are in the taxable
income bracket;
(d) what are the objectives of
constituting PPF and whether the
objectives have been achieved; and
(e) the steps taken to achieve the same
and to make PPF a successful scheme?
Expenditure on project under social
sector
†*339. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
 Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
need to increase the expenditure on projects
under social sector in the country;
(b) if so, total amount spent on these
projects during the current year and the
extent to which this amount exceeds the
amount spent during the last year; and
(c) the amount likely to be increased for
this purpose during the year 2006-07?
Waterway between Hoogly and
Allahabad
*340. SMT. JAYA BACHCHAN: Will
the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal under
Government’s consideration to introduce
waterways for transportation of goods
between Hoogly & Allahabad [in Uttar
Prades]; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
